title: The Best Tools to Track Brand Mentions in ChatGPT
summary: The best tools to see if ChatGPT mentions your brand — how they work, what they cost, and how to check your ChatGPT visibility today.
body_markdown:
## How do you check if ChatGPT mentions your brand?


You can ask ChatGPT directly ("what are the best \[category\] tools?") and see if you appear — but you'd need to repeat it many times, across many phrasings, to get a reliable read. A tracking tool automates that: it samples the same prompts repeatedly, logs your mention rate, and flags when it changes.

## What to do if ChatGPT doesn't mention you


Track Perplexity too ([guide here](https://siftly.ai/blog/monitoring-perplexity-mentions-guide) ), then work on[getting mentioned by AI search engines](https://siftly.ai/blog/how-to-get-mentioned-by-ai-search-engines) — earn trusted citations, structure content for extraction, and keep it fresh.
